title: OpenAI announces plans to shut down its Sora video generator - Ars Technica
summary: OpenAI is shutting down Sora, a video-generation app that launched in late 2024, following a decision to refocus on business and productivity applications. This move comes after a $1 billion investment from Disney and amidst uncertainty about the future of the partnership.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the app shutdown and the uncertainty surrounding the investment and partnership with Disney.
